ORDINANCE, 2001 OF THE INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 2001.
Please refer to your application for recognition of Provident Fund under section 1(1)/Part-I, Sixth Schedule of the Income
Tax Ordinance, 2001 through IRIS system.
It is informed that no action was taken on the application due to non-availability of the required documents. You are
requested to provide all the documents as required under rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules 2002 to proceed further in the
matter by 18-11-2022. Please note that in case of non-compliance/unsatisfactory reply by the due date, the application will
be finalized as per law.

Subject:
NOTICE UNDER RULE 92(2) OF THE INCOME TAX RULES, 2002 FOR REFUSAL OF AN
APPLICATION OF RECOGNISED PROVIDENT FUNDS UNDER PART-I, SIXTH SCHEDULE OF THE INCOME TAX
ORDINANCE, 2001 IN THE CASE OF ZAMEEN MEDIA EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND TRUST-NTN: A022432: T.Y
2021:
Please refer to your application under Part-I, Sixth Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 for
recognized Provident Funds through IRIS system dated 16-07-2021
It is to inform you that all trusts are required to be registered under Punjab Trust Act, 2020 but as per record available in
this office, you have not provided the proof of registration under this act.
2.
It is pertinent to mention here that the trust has been given the status of company for tax purposes by
virtue of section 80(2)(b)(vb) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. The relevant portion of above section is reproduced as
under:
“a trust, an entity or a body of persons established or constituted by or under any law for the time being in force.”
3.
In order to provide for improved monitoring and evaluation of Trusts, the Trust Act, 1882 was repealed
and new Trust Acts, 2020 were enacted by each Provincial Government applicable within their respective territorial
jurisdiction.
4.
According to Section 5 of Punjab Trust Act, 2020:
(1) No trust in relation to an immovable property shall be valid unless declared by a non-testamentary instrument in writing
signed by the author of the trust and the trustee, and duly registered, or by the will of the author of the trust or of the trustee
Printed on

Tue, 19 Nov 2024 15:32:17

1(1) / Part I Sixth Sch. (Application for recognition to Provident Fund)

Name: ZAMEEN MEDIA EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND TRUST
Address: 94 B/1, PEARL ONE, MM ALAM ROAD,
GULBERG-III, LAHORE, Lahore Gulberg Town
Contact No: 00923078818934

Registration No A022432
Tax Year : 2021
Period : 01-Jul-2020 - 30-Jun-2021
Medium : Online
Due Date : 16-Jul-2021
Document Date 16-Jul-2021

and ownership of the property is transferred to the trust.
(2) No trust in relation to movable property shall be valid unless declared in the manner as given under subsection (1), or
unless the ownership of the property is transferred to the trust.
5.
In view of the above, one can easily decipher that if a trust is not registered, it is not valid. Also, it is a
settled principle of law that when a statute is couched in negative language, it is all the more mandatory or peremptory.
Reference in this regard is made to the law laid down in the cases PLD 2020 ISB 378, 1995 SCMR 1249, 1991 SCMR 599,
PLD 1986 SC 178, PLD 1971 SC 61 and 2007 CLC 315. Keeping in view of the above, the use of the words in above said
section “No trust in relation to movable property shall be valid unless….” having negative connotation plainly makes the
requirement of registering the trust mandatory and imperative.
6.
The newly enacted Provincial Trust Acts have created a mandatory requirement for registration of existing
trusts created under the repealed Trust Act, 1882, therefore, the tax exemptions under the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001
will not apply unless the existing or new trusts are registered in terms of the criteria necessitated by provincial trust laws.
7.
You are, therefore, requested to provide proof of registration under the said Act. Please note that in case
of non-compliance/unsatisfactory reply by 06.01.2023, the instant application for recognized Provident Funds under Part-I,
Sixth Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 will be refused/rejected under Rule 92(4) of the Income Tax Rules,
2002.
(MUHAMMAD TAQI QURESHI)
COMMISSIONER INLAND REVENUE

2021:
Please refer to your application under Part-I, Sixth Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 for
recognized Provident Funds through IRIS system dated 16-07-2021
It is to inform you that all trusts are required to be registered under Punjab Trust Act, 2020 but as per record
available in this office, you have not provided the proof of registration under this act.
2.
It is further informed that a show cause notice was also issued to you on 30-12-2022 for compliance by
06-12-2022. No compliance has been made till date. You are, hereby, provided another final opportunity of being heard
through this notice to submit the proof of registration under the said Act and to explain your position by 17.01.2023. Please
note that in case of non-compliance/unsatisfactory reply, the instant application for recognized Provident Funds under PartI, Sixth Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 will be refused/rejected under Rule 92(4) of the Income Tax Rules,
2002.

SUBJECT:
APPLICATION FOR RECOGNITION OF PROVIDENT FUND UNDER 1(1)/PART I OF SIXTH
SCHEDULE OF THE INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 2001
Please refer to your application on the subject.
I am directed to inform you that the following documents are required to examine your application for consideration in the
instant matter:
1.
Trust deed registered under Trust Act 2020 in original as per Sub Rule (3) of Rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules,
2002.
2.
Income Tax Return for the preceding year(s) as per Sub Rule (1) of Rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules, 2002.
3.
Attested copy of audited account for the preceding year(s) as per Sub Rule (1) of Rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules,
2002.
4.
Detail of investment(s) as per Sub Rule (1) of Rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules, 2002.
5.
The Rules of Funds as per Sub Rule (5) of Rule 91 of the Income Tax Rules, 2002.
6.
Abstract for the fund’s accounting period of individual account as per Sub Rule (3) of Rule 95 of the Income Tax
Rules, 2002.
You are requested to provide above documents by 31.08.2023 to proceed further in the matter. Please note in case of noncompliance/ unsatisfactory reply, the application will be finalized as per law.

FIZA BATOOL
COMMISSIONER INLAND REVENUE
ZONE-I, CTO, LAHORE
